justifications.durability: negative-control.log shows the two-line guard removed reinstates the defect and reddens tests/test_plain_text_finding_does_not_stop_a_re_review.py:205 with AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'get', which is exactly the regression it guards; the disposal assertion at :222 discriminates against a dropped or misindexed write because the fixture seeds finding 1 with a different exemption, though its expected value is the reason the test itself supplied.

justifications.fit: the guard sits inside the single severity reader as one isinstance branch with a docstring paragraph in the module's own explanatory voice, and the new test follows the per-file _git/_commit fixture idiom of tests/test_a_review_with_no_base_is_not_carried.py:33 rather than introducing a shared helper the repo does not have.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/review.py:223-224 routes a bare-string finding to _severity_stated_in_text, which applies the same leading-word rule every record finding's claim uses, and the production composer at recovery_review_subject.py:574 needs no change because it already reads through declared_severity and finding_claim.
justifications.reuse: the added branch reuses finding_claim and the module's existing _SEVERITY_PREFIX at reckon/crew/review.py:180 rather than adding a second severity parser; a search of the tree and of tests/ for a competing severity reader or git-fixture owner found none outside this one reader, and _git/_commit are duplicated per file by established convention across a dozen test modules.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff (reckon/crew/review.py, tests/test_plain_text_finding_does_not_stop_a_re_review.py, the evidence fragment) lies inside the manifest's declared write paths listed in orientation_write_paths, and nothing else changed.
